This '''mission''' took place on the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] in [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. Following a [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|skirmish]] over [[Phaegon III]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] a the outbreak of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the ''Harbinger'' entered an unstable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and [[Time travel/Legends|traveled]] through [[Time/Legends|time]] to 41.5 ABY. There, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]], who had sabotaged the ''Harbinger'' during the previous skirmish, met up with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Scavenger/Legends|salvagers]] [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]]. The ''Harbinger''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] remained inoperable, and Druur wanted to attempt another mission to destroy it's dangerous cargo, a powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] known as [[Lignan]]. However, he was also motivated by the dark side itself; he wished revenge for the recent [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Drev Hassin]], during the skirmish over Phaegon III, as well as on [[Saes Rrogon]], a former apprentice of his who had turned to the dark side and become ''Harbinger''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Idi-Shael helped Druur get aboard the ''Harbinger'' and assisted in his infiltration of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], before fleeing. Druur then made his way to the Lignan in the ship's cargo hold, where he awaited the arrival of Rrogon. When Rrogon arrived, he engaged the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in a duel of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], and Rrogon eventually gained the upper hand, clenching Druur in a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|Force Choke]]. Druur, however, called on the power of the Lignan and managed to defeat his former apprentice, finally stabbing Rrogon with Rrogon's own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He then continued to draw on the power of the Lignan, allowing it to consume him as he died, finally unleashing it upon the ''Harbinger''. The ship was destroyed in the flames.
